title: Inter's best team right now is the women's team
caption:
Inter Women go to Milan this morning for the first derby of the season — four wins, one draw, ten goals scored and none conceded in five games, per Inter.it. Sportmediaset now puts Carlos Augusto ahead of Dimarco at left back for Como on Sunday.
